about.title: About the pack
about.body:
The Woof Woof Woof Club is a fully qualified, professional dog care service based in Chester.

We're DEFRA approved and hold a 5-star licence under Cheshire West & Chester (19/AB/119). We're DBS checked, fully insured, affiliated with Pro Dog Trainer and gold-accredited by NARPS UK.

Whether your dog needs an adventure walk, a training plan, a sleepover or just a friendly face popping in — we treat every animal like family. Dogs, cats, chickens and the occasional llama all welcome.

testimonials.name: Sarah & Biscuit
testimonials.text: Biscuit starts wagging the second we turn onto their street. The walks are clearly the highlight of his week!

testimonials.name: Mark T.
testimonials.text: The training work transformed our rescue from a nervous wreck into a confident, happy boy. Can't recommend enough.

testimonials.name: The Patel family

testimonials.name: Jenny W.
testimonials.text: They even look after our chickens when we're away. Nothing is too much trouble — genuinely lovely people.

contact.blurb: Your pet is family — and we get that. Give us a bark, we're always happy to chat about what your furry (or feathered) friend needs.
